title: A register CSV dropped into a batch stays in that batch and is read as a table there
runtime: not run; no Docker, database or browser in this task

decisions.D1: A CSV or XLSX dropped on the batch page, or in one drop with a file that makes a batch, joins that batch as its own item (kept through /uploads) and is kept before the drop's map files. A table dropped alone with no batch keeps the N01 table import.
decisions.D2: The words 'cannot be attached to a site' are the Studio's own refusal in readSourceCase; the server has no site rule. The N01 import keeps it. N01B's Read as a table now reads the batch case through readBatchCase, which refuses only an archived case. On the server, the package rule of workspace() still refuses a case linked to a recorded property for every caller, and a package case for every caller except a table read (tableFromOriginal, attachTableTx, and the profile read of a table) of a source the case keeps as an intake item.
decisions.D3: The evidence-by-key declare form reads the table profile of each kept CSV or workbook of the batch while a key is declared; a read table is offered with the headers and selection of its read, so a read workbook is offered too. An unread CSV keeps its card headers; an unread workbook is not offered.
